items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 drops October 22 with Edgerunners 2 content
Cyberpunk 2077 is finally getting the co-op mode gamers have wanted for 6 years
items.summary: Night City is about to get a lot more chaotic with friends 😂🎮
items.content:
Take over Night City with friends by your side!

Cyberpunk 2077 is getting what looks to be a seamless co-op mode, letting friends explore Night City together six years after fans first hoped to experience the story campaign in multiplayer.

Depending on your perspective, some gamers would love to see multiplayer co-op in open-world games. The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4 could be even better with a friend, while Red Dead Redemption 2 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt might be better off without it.

One other game that could benefit from having co-op multiplayer is the aforementioned Cyberpunk 2077 from CD Projekt RED , and as stated at the top of this article, a talented modder is making it happen.

While NightCoop is currently a work in progress, the developers intend to begin public testing on the unofficial mode on October 23, 2026. In its current closed testing phase, the mod covers the prologue and Act 1 of the Cyberpunk 2077 campaign.

When development is complete, NightCoop aims to let up to eight players explore Night City together online. Each player will control their own version of V, with multiple-choice dialogue decisions determined by a vote among players. What's more, the cinematic cutscenes will remain intact.

It's worth noting that NightCoop isn't the only Cyberpunk 2077 multiplayer project in development. While NightCoop aims to bring co-op to the story campaign, OPEN//77 focuses on multiplayer servers and custom activities, offering a different way to experience Night City with other players.

READ MORE: Cyberpunk 2077's Night City just got an immersive new feature amid wait for Project Orion

READ MORE: Cyberpunk 2077 players can now possess enemies in free mod, opening up a whole new play style

Sadly, as is the case with all Cyberpunk 2077 mods, NightCoop is a PC exclusive and is not available on consoles. Cyberpunk 2077 and its Phantom Liberty expansion are also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 Could Be Its Biggest Update Since Phantom Liberty
items.summary: CD PROJEKT RED continues expanding Night City with a free update arriving October 22, introducing new gameplay features, customization options, and content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Jus…
items.content:
CD PROJEKT RED continues expanding Night City with a free update arriving October 22, introducing new gameplay features, customization options, and content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

Just when it seemed CD PROJEKT RED had finished expanding Cyberpunk 2077, the studio has announced another potentially substantial update to its acclaimed open-world RPG. Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 , officially titled the Edgerunners 2 Update, arrives October 22, 2026, bringing new content inspired by the recently released Netflix anime alongside additional gameplay features and items.

Nearly six years after its original release, Cyberpunk 2077 continues to evolve, and Update 2.5 could become one of its most significant additions since Phantom Liberty and the transformative Update 2.0 overhaul in 2023.

Among the reported additions surrounding Update 2.5 are dual-wielding and expanded cyberware customization, two features that could further enhance the game’s already impressive combat and progression systems.

Dual-wielding, in particular, has been a long-requested feature among players. Its inclusion could introduce another layer of flexibility to Cyberpunk 2077’s combat, especially for those who prefer aggressive, fast-paced gunplay.

Cyberware customization is equally intriguing. Following the massive changes introduced in Update 2.0, cybernetic enhancements became an essential component of character builds, influencing everything from survivability to mobility and combat effectiveness. Further customization could provide players with even more freedom in how they develop V.

However, the extent of these additions and how they’ll function remains unclear until CD PROJEKT RED provides its full breakdown.

Phantom Liberty and Update 2.0 represented a defining moment for Cyberpunk 2077, fundamentally restructuring its progression, perks, combat mechanics, and cyberware systems.

Since then, CD PROJEKT RED has continued improving Night City through several free updates. Update 2.1 introduced the NCART metro system, expanded romantic interactions, and additional activities, while subsequent releases brought vehicle customization, Photo Mode improvements, and numerous quality-of-life refinements.

What makes Update 2.5 particularly interesting is its potential to introduce new gameplay possibilities rather than simply refine existing features.

Alongside the anticipated combat and customization additions, players can expect content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, which premiered on Netflix on October 20 with ten episodes featuring an entirely new cast and standalone story.

If these features prove substantial, Update 2.5 could become one of Cyberpunk 2077’s most meaningful free updates in years.

CD PROJEKT RED will reveal additional details during a special REDstreams presentation on October 21 , with official patch notes scheduled for publication the same day.

Personally, what makes this announcement exciting is that Cyberpunk 2077 continues receiving attention well beyond its original release. Night City remains one of gaming’s most visually striking and immersive environments, but it’s the freedom to experiment with weapons, cyberware, and different character builds that makes returning so satisfying.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Boss Drops F-Bomb Hyping Secret Update 2.5 Plans
Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2, New on Netflix, Confirms a Popular Fan Theory From 2077
items.summary: In Netflix's Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2, a popular fan theory from Cyberpunk 2077 has been confirmed. Let’s talk about cyberpsychosis…
items.content:
Full spoilers follow for Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 , which is available now on Netflix.

When Cyberpunk Edgerunners premiered in 2022 , fans discovered a phenomenal season of television. Not only was it one of the best sci-fi shows of all time, but also a prime example of a video game adaptation done right, with just enough connections to the source material that they don’t impact the show’s story but still provide some nods for longtime fans. More importantly, it captured the essence of CD Projekt Red’s Cyberpunk 2077 , from its themes to its world, while also delivering an emotionally devastating story through stunning visuals — and a whole lot of brutal violence.

Edgerunners 2, which is designed as a standalone sequel series, does things a bit differently. This season still offers high levels of gore and violence, incredible animation, and themes of the evil of corporations and how they destroy everything they touch. What it does differently is incorporate into its plot not only the story of the first season of Edgerunners, but even elements from Cyberpunk 2077. That’s because a big part of Edgerunners 2 deals with Soulkiller, a program introduced in Cyberpunk 2077 as capable of digitizing the mind of a person and storing it on a chip. When inserted in another person, the digital entity from the chip slowly takes over its host and eventually kills the body’s original mind. Though it is very much a death sentence, fans of the game have long theorized that there might be an unintentional side benefit to Soulkiller — namely, a cure for cyberpsychosis.

In the world of the show and game, cyberpsychosis is a dissociative disorder that affects humans who have replaced much of their organic bodies with cybernetics. As the body rejects the chrome parts, cyberpsychosis starts to affect their minds, to the point where they no longer see themselves as people, but rather as machines with replaceable parts. This disorder manifests as an outburst where the victim disassociates and becomes violent, their brain taken over by hallucinations. In the world of Edgerunners, cyberpsychosis is portrayed as something unavoidable, a forgone conclusion the moment you start replacing your body with cybernetics. You can’t prevent it, and you can’t stop it.

But what if you can? According to a popular fan theory, the main character of Cyberpunk 2077, V, never experiences cyberpsychosis because of their interaction with the chip containing the Soulkiller program. It is the digitized entity within the chip that heals V’s emerging cyberpsychosis, as it is programmed to prepare its host body in order to take over it. Without the chip and the Soulkiller entity, V would succumb to cyberpsychosis.

We see this happen in the second half of Edgerunners 2. This season, we’re introduced to Talia, a young woman suffering from a serious if undisclosed illness. Additionally, Talia’s cybernetic implants have her on the verge of cyberpsychosis, with a doctor saying she will be lost at any minute. And yet, the moment she comes in contact with a chip containing a Soulkiller entity known as Capri, Talia’s health improves significantly and at an abnormal rate. Her brain is healed, her body is repaired, and cyberpsychosis is no longer an issue — until the chip is eventually removed and Talia reverts back to how she was, with her future uncertain.

Granted, Soulkiller is portrayed in Edgerunners as more of a weapon than anything else. Capri is described as an amalgamation of different digital constructs, which seems more like an AI made out of several individuals rather than a single one. She’s designed specifically to be the ultimate killing machine, but in addition to destroying her host body’s previous consciousness, the test subjects all die within days of getting the Capri chip inserted. This is why the Arasaka Corporation was going after people like Talia and David from Season 1, as they are known to have a high tolerance for cybernetics.

Returning to Cyberpunk 2077 or playing it for the first time? We’ve got a new and improved Cyberpunk interactive map to help you find every mission, Iconic item, and collectible in the game. Plus, we’ve also got a full walkthrough for the base game, a Phantom Liberty walkthrough , and an overview of all the Cyberpunk 2077 endings so you don’t make a choice you regret. And we can’t ignore the various romance options you can smooch, which also impact how V’s story concludes.

Cyberpunk Edgerunners Season 2 takes a different approach to adapting the world of Cyberpunk 2077. Though still very much an original story, this season is more intrinsically connected to the game; it feels more like a side story happening during the events of the game that the player simply didn’t get to witness. The use of the Soulkiller program serves to connect the show and the game in an interesting way without taking away from either of the separate stories. Instead, knowing the larger story of the Soulkiller from Cyberpunk 2077 makes the story of Talia and Capri hit harder because it’s one of countless similar stories in Night City.

Sure, this season doesn’t have a story as emotionally resonant as David’s from the first season, but it still very much tells an effective tale about people who get screwed by corporations. Talia may come from a family of money and power, but that can’t save her. Night City devours everyone and everything within it, and there’s no winning in that place… Though having a Soulkiller chip might help a bit if you are on the verge of cyberpsychosis.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 confirms free update for this week as CD Projekt RED returns to the hit RPG
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a new free update, which apparently includes "dual-wielding" and "cyberware customisation"! 😄
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2077's new free update includes "cyberware customisation" and "dual-wielding".

CD Projekt Red has announced update 2.5 for Cyberpunk 2077 , with release set for later this week and a bigger reveal on October 21.

Originally released in 2020, Cyberpunk 2077 has gone through a massive number of changes over the years from its initial botched launch.

Update 2.0 was a huge overhaul to the game which brought in many new features and overhauls, with subsequent patches also adding in a load of new content for players to enjoy.

Now, CD Projekt Red has announced Update 2.5 for Cyberpunk 2077 , coinciding with the release of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 and brings with it a load of new stuff.

The exact details of what's awaiting us is unclear, but CDPR has teased that "cyberware customization" and "a new dual-wielding playstyle" will be among the list of new features.

A full breakdown of the patch will air tomorrow on REDstreams, CDPR's own branding for the livestreams it does which shed light on the game and reveal future patches. After that, the patch will launch for the game on October 22, 2026.

The next REDstreams occurs tomorrow, October 21 at 5 PM CEST, on either Twitch, YouTube, or Steam.

The update was announced with some new artwork by Taisei Uchida (Original Art), Yukiko Kakita (Ink & Paint Check), and Yuichiro Tozawa (Special Effects), who were commissioned to create the artwork featured in the update announcement.

The last major update to Cyberpunk 2077 was Update 2.3 which came in June 2025 . It added four new vehicles, big improvements to Photo Mode, and other changes to the way lighting was rendered in-game. It also featured new accessibility and quality of life features, along with plenty of bug fixes.

With the reveal that Update 2.5 will feature dual-wielding and cyberware customisation, it looks like Cyberpunk 2077 fans are in for a treat as CDPR will add new content that goes beyond simple bug fixes and small changes.

Since the update also heralds the arrival of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 , be aware that some of the new content in the patch will likely also include references to the new season. The show is set prior to the events of the game, but that doesn't mean there won't be any way for CDPR to include it in the game.

Still, it looks like CD Projekt Red isn't done with the game just yet, despite previously stating that no more major patches would be coming to Cyberpunk 2077 . Considering that it's still got big plans for both it and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt though, we'd say that a lot more is probably on the way.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 airs on Netflix this week, with all ten episodes available to watch from today.

items.title: Hideo Kojima Confirmed to Reprise Cyberpunk 2077 Role in Edgerunners 2 Anime Cameo
items.summary: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 has cast Metal Gear Solid creator Hideo Kojima in a role that will see him reprise his part from Cyberpunk 2077.
items.content:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 has cast Metal Gear Solid creator Hideo Kojima in a role that will see him reprise his part from Cyberpunk 2077 .

Series game developer CD Projekt Red confirmed the news in a social media post on X/Twitter . The message teased that it's more than a throwaway part, too, as Kojima will be seen playing "the famous braindance director who was at Konpeki Plaza in Cyberpunk 2077" (via X's machine translation).

The real-life game director was quick to respond and share his excitement, as well as a few pictures from his time recording his lines. His full statement, minus a few fun emojis, is as follows: "I make a cameo appearance in the anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 as Hideyoshi Oshima, the character who appeared in the previous game."

I make a cameo appearance in the anime series “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2” as Hideyoshi Oshima, the character who appeared in the previous game. 🙏🙇🏻😅🫶👍 https://t.co/OuUaazFfR4

Cyberpunk 2077 players were treated to an unexpected visit from the Kojima Productions lead when they first traveled to Night City back in 2020. It's a moment that wasn't actually directly tied to V's mainline quest and surprisingly easy to miss, but yes, if players search Arasaka's Konpeki Plaza hard enough, they can find Kojima sitting near a bar.

If you're familiar with Kojima's work on games like Metal Gear Solid and Death Stranding, what he had to say in the Cyberpunk world wasn't too surprising. He enjoyed chatting about the in-universe memory-exploring mechanic, braindances, as he wanted his "productions to convey real, raw human emotion." When stopped by V, he asks the player if they have any pitches to show him.

"The feeling when you combine happiness and melancholy, or being calm with an underlying sense of anxiety," he says in the game. "These complex, realistic feelings and emotions are what I aspire to recreate... woven into much better stories, of course."

Kojima's Oshima will now bring his love for braindance technology to Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 when it premieres tomorrow, October 20, 2026. All 10 episodes of the second season will drop at the same time. IGN called this second anime trip into Night City "Amazing" in our 9/10 review .

"Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 delivers the gory, action-packed goods, even if it doesn’t quite hit the highs of its predecessor,” we said.

Kojima is hard at work on games like Physint and OD , but that doesn't mean he hasn't had time for one or even a few cameos. We know now that Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 was one of the few anime projects he teased earlier this month, but we're still waiting to see the "big movie" he filmed .

Returning to Cyberpunk 2077 or playing it for the first time? We’ve got a new and improved Cyberpunk interactive map to help you find every mission, Iconic item, and collectible in the game. Plus, we’ve also got a full walkthrough for the base game, a Phantom Liberty walkthrough , and an overview of all the Cyberpunk 2077 endings so you don’t make a choice you regret. And we can’t ignore the various romance options you can smooch, which also impact how V’s story concludes.

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

items.title: Patch 2.31
items.summary: Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live! This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below: Vehicles Updated Aut
items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]

items.title: Update 2.3 Patch Notes
items.summary: Update 2.3 lands tomorrow! Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as sup
items.content:
Update 2.3 lands tomorrow!

Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as support for AMD FSR 3.1 Frame Generation, Intel XeSS 2.0 and HDR10+ Gaming, among others.

Update 2.3 also brings Cyberpunk 2077 to a whole new platform: Mac with Apple silicon! If you already own the game on Steam, you can play it on your compatible device. To find out whether your Mac can run Cyberpunk 2077, please check the official requirements.

Read the list of changes for more info:

Vehicles

  • Added 4 new vehicles, including several Side Jobs tied to acquiring them:

    • Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Hunt and The Beast In Me).

      An additional side job unlocks the CrystalCoat™ feature for it.

      [/*]

    • Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred"

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Beast in Me: Badlands, The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo, Transmission, and Search and Destroy)."

      [/*]

    • Yaiba ASM-R250 Muramasa

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, purchase 1 Yaiba vehicle, purchase at least 3 vehicles through AUTOFIXER, and complete Reported Crime: You Play with Fire...).

      If you fail the side job, the vehicle can later be purchased through AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]

    • Chevillon Legatus 450 Aquila

      Available for purchase on AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Introducing AutoDrive! This cutting-edge, autonomous driving feature will take you to your chosen destination (i.e. job objective or placed pin on the map). If you have no set destination, it will take you on a leisurely ride through the streets of Night City. Simply hop in any of your vehicles, make sure you're on a road, and hold G (PC) / Left Stick (consoles) to activate. This feature is disabled when you enter combat or when your vehicle is heavily damaged.

    [/*]

  • Implemented Cinematic Camera for AutoDrive. Hold Q (PC) / D-Pad Right (consoles) to activate. Sit back and enjoy cinematic views of Night City as you cruise toward your destination.

    [/*]

  • Self-driving Delamain cabs are now available on demand! Simply open the menu to call vehicles, then select "Delamain Cab" from the list to request a ride. This feature unlocks after completing the job Don't Lose Your Mind (regardless of outcome) and receiving a message from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ is now available for vehicles from partner brands, including motorcycles. Additionally, the infamous hacker known as Cosmetic_Troll exploited a vulnerability and created a cracked version of Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology for lower-end vehicles. Please note, however, that some models do not support the technology, such as heavily modded nomad vehicles and job-related vehicles.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color schemes did not work properly on the Mizutani Shion MZ1 and MZ2.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color scheme could not be applied properly to the Villefort Deleon "Vindicator".

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Added 27 new NPCs that can be spawned in Photo Mode, including Rita Wheeler, the Cassel twins, fixers, Dum Dum, the iguana, Brendan, and more.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between alternative outfits for NPCs spawned in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between V's saved Wardrobe outfits in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • Added a confirmation pop-up when exiting Photo Mode to prevent accidental exits after setting up the perfect shot.

    [/*]

  • Added more customization options to the Look-At Camera feature, including an option for only the character's eyes to turn toward the camera instead of their entire body.

    [/*]

  • Added improvements to Lighting:

    • Lights now spawn around the camera instead of the player character.

      [/*]

    • Added an outline to the spotlight mesh and an indicator when it's off screen for better visibility.

      [/*]

    • Improved light movement speed on controllers.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added multiple new stickers and frames, including iconic quotes and stylish overlays that let you turn your screenshots into Night City postcards – perfect for sharing memories from the City of Dreams.

    [/*]

  • Improved Depth of Field and moved it to the Camera tab.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Color Balance tab, allowing you to create your own custom filters.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Time and Weather tab:

    • Weather: includes rain, acid rain, fog, sandstorm, pollution, and sunny.

      [/*]

    • Time of Day: changes the time of day within Photo Mode.

      [/*]

    • Frame Forward: advances through an unlimited amount of frames to capture the perfect shot.
